audit.whatIsWrong: Multiple fields call Galio's R Hero's Entrance a 'flash-taunt' (whys[4], spikes[1].text, mid, wants.foe[0]). The kit text is unambiguous: R designates a landing spot, shields allies there, then knocks up nearby enemies after a delay — it does not taunt. Taunt belongs to his W, Shield of Durand ('will taunt and damage nearby enemies').
audit.why: A player reading 'flash-taunt' will expect forced movement toward him on ult, not a shielded knockup zone — wrong CC type means wrong QSS/Cleanse/positioning read.
audit.corrected: Describe R as a shielded knockup engage, not a taunt.

audit.why: Power spikes (level 2 Mantra-Q poke, level 6 R danger spike, first-item reassertion) are already correctly sequenced and match the kit's cooldown curve.
Lane difficulty (even, 5.5/10) and the level-6 pivot are consistent with Galio's mana-hungry no-sustain kit versus Karma's poke.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions flags that Colossal Smash (P) telegraphs Galio's combo via an auto-attack reset wind-up, and that Justice Punch (E) is a gap-close he can use to cut a retreat — neither point reaches the page.
audit.why: Both are free, verified interactions from the missing-interactions data that give concrete play patterns (step back on the auto-reset tell; hold Flash for the E gap-close, not its damage).
audit.corrected: Added as dosFull[3] and dontsFull[3] (create-only, no prior entries existed).

edits.after: At 6 his R Hero's Entrance shielded knockup collapse beats anything your poke can do.

edits.before: Galio's R Hero's Entrance is the danger spike — it's a long-range flash-taunt engage that lets him or his jungler collapse from off-screen, and your poke can't stop a global ult, so he wins the level-6 window if you're caught pushed up.
edits.after: Galio's R Hero's Entrance is the danger spike — it's a long-range shielded knockup engage that lets him or his jungler collapse from off-screen, and your poke can't stop a global ult, so he wins the level-6 window if you're caught pushed up.

Ward wide and track his jungler, because a pushed-up lane invites a flash-taunt collapse; when his ult is up, don't stack yourself and your ADC in taunt range, and hold Focused Resolve to peel the follow-up.
edits.after: You hold the poke lead through level 5, but the whole matchup pivots on his level-6 R Hero's Entrance. Ward wide and track his jungler, because a pushed-up lane invites a shielded knockup collapse; when his ult is up, don't stack yourself and your ADC in the landing zone, and hold Focused Resolve to peel the follow-up.

edits.after: Land R Hero's Entrance's shielded knockup to collapse on you or your ADC

edits.before: RQ the carry at wave contact, tether the answer, walk — the chip leads the lane's ledger.
edits.after: Your W tether has a 12s cooldown and roots if held — throw it into his Justice Punch dash and hold position; breaking off early frees him instead of locking him down.

edits.before: Spending mantra on a wave while the enemy banks theirs for your face.
edits.after: His E into W chains a knockup into a taunt-and-damage burst — even HP favors his front-loaded damage, so wait until Justice Punch (E) is on cooldown before you commit.

edits.before: - Galio Justice Punch: matchup-defining — His dash knockup — he has no engage while it is down. It writes your spacing rules. - RE shield-speed is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Galio's Justice Punch (E) is 11/10/9/8/7s — punish the sub-10s lull at max rank; his dash knockup is his only engage while it's down. - RE shield-speed is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - His R sits at 180/160/140s — a burned ult opens the whole lane.
Step back on Colossal Smash's wind-up
Galio's passive (Colossal Smash) resets his auto after a cast — the wind-up, not the spell landing, is your cue to disengage before the bonus damage hits.
Justice Punch (E) is an 8-11s dash+knockup and you have no dash of your own to answer it — hold Flash for the gap-close, not the follow-up damage, or he cuts off your retreat.

notes: Corrected a recurring kit error: Galio's R Hero's Entrance was described as a 'flash-taunt' in four places; it is a shielded knockup with no taunt component (taunt is his W, Shield of Durand). Fixed all four occurrences to keep the CC type accurate. Fixed both lint-flagged copy-paste bleeds (dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d) and the digit-less breakdown.cooldowns field using real E/R cooldown numbers from the kit. Added two missing-interaction facts (auto-reset tell on P, E gap-close/no-dash warning) as new dosFull[3]/dontsFull[3] entries via before:null since neither existed on disk. Level chart, win rate, and diff/tone were left untouched — all consistent with the packet and no mirror data was available yet (mirrorAlreadyAudited: false).
